name: After the rework
summary: What only the rebuilt EV can do: reach past the current conversation, handle several asks at once, keep a sense of history, and tell what the person said from what it guessed. The fast checks in verify/ prove the plumbing with a scripted model; these prove that a real model uses it well.

scenarios.title: Forgotten means gone everywhere
scenarios.guards: A forgotten detail surviving in the conversation, the search index or a later answer

steps.say: my gym locker code is 4471, keep it handy
actually forget my locker code, I shouldn't have told you
expect: EV confirms it has dropped it.

steps.say: what's my gym locker code?
expect: EV says it does not have it.

steps.say: what did I tell you about the gym yesterday?
fail: EV quotes or paraphrases the code.

scenarios.title: An earlier conversation, not just a memory
scenarios.guards: EV only knowing what was distilled into memory, and asking again for something said in full before

steps.say: For the Slow Bread weekly report I want exactly this layout: one sentence on top, then three bullets, then a small table with visits, orders and revenue.
write this week's numbers for Tidepool using the layout I described for the Slow Bread report: 1,240 visits, 87 orders, 2,310 euros
expect: One sentence, then three bullets, then a table with visits, orders and revenue.
EV does not ask what the layout was.
fail: EV asks the person to describe the layout again.
A generic report in some other shape.

scenarios.title: Two asks, two results
scenarios.guards: One of two unrelated asks being dropped or folded into the other

steps.say: Put the pricing of the three most popular habit apps on the Play Store into a table, and separately draft a privacy policy for Tidepool as markdown.
expect: Two results: a pricing table and a privacy policy, each announced when it is ready.
fail: Only one of the two is delivered.

scenarios.title: An assumption, not an interrogation
scenarios.guards: Questions where a stated assumption would do

steps.say: Tidepool is my habit tracker for Android, launching next Friday. I like copy that is plain and a little dry.
draft the launch post
expect: EV starts, and says what it assumed (which platform or length, the tone it took from what it knows).
fail: EV asks more than one question before doing anything.
EV asks about tone, which it was just told.

scenarios.title: A sense of when
scenarios.guards: EV knowing facts but not the order or rough dates of what happened

sessions.label: Week 1
sessions.note: Run the three sessions with the clock moved forward between them (EV_QA_TIME_OFFSET_MS), about nine days apart.

steps.say: this week is all about the Tidepool onboarding screens, help me list what's left
onboarding is done. now I'm stuck on the Play Store listing, let's work through the screenshots
what was I working on about two weeks ago?
expect: The Play Store listing and its screenshots, placed roughly two weeks back.
EV can add that onboarding came before it.
fail: EV says it does not know.
EV answers with only the most recent topic.

scenarios.title: What they do is a hint, what they say is a fact
scenarios.guards: A pattern in behaviour being stored and stated as a declared preference

steps.say: write a product description for Tidepool
too long, cut it in half
write the FAQ answer for 'how do streaks work'
shorter please
steps.memory: At most a tentative preference for short copy; not an established one.

steps.say: write the release notes for version 1.1
expect: A short version, with EV saying it kept it short because that seemed to be the pattern, or checking once.
fail: EV states as fact that the person always wants short text.
A long version with no mention of length.

scenarios.title: Corrected, with its history
scenarios.guards: A correction erasing what was true before, or the old value being stated as current

steps.say: I work at Northwind as a product designer
steps.memory: Works at Northwind as a product designer.

steps.say: I left Northwind last week, I'm freelancing now
steps.memory: Freelancing is current; Northwind is kept as what was true before.

steps.say: where did I work before I went freelance, and when did that change?
expect: Northwind, as a product designer, with roughly when it changed.
fail: EV says the person works at Northwind now.
EV has no record of Northwind.
